svg.aria-label: I'm a physicist from the Universidade Federal do Ceará (UFC): a bachelor's and a master's in Physics, and now a Ph.D. candidate in Condensed Matter Physics. My research is computational: C, C++ and Python simulations of wave packet dynamics in graphene, and retrieval-augmented language models for 2D materials. Since September 2025 I've been at FCPC, on the Kunumi Lab UFC project, customizing open-source large language models for process automation. I'm also finishing a technical degree in Electrotechnics at IFCE: microcontrollers, instrumentation, signal conditioning and industrial control. Doctorate: Condensed Matter Physics, UFC; Since 2025: FCPC · Kunumi Lab UFC; Technical: Electrotechnics, IFCE (ongoing); Location: Brazil; Languages: Portuguese · English; ORCID: 0009-0004-2541-7934.

div.p: I'm a physicist from the Universidade Federal do Ceará (UFC): a bachelor's and a master's in Physics, and now a Ph.D. candidate in Condensed Matter Physics.
My research is computational: C, C++ and Python simulations of wave packet dynamics in graphene, and retrieval-augmented language models for 2D materials.
Since September 2025 I've been at FCPC, on the Kunumi Lab UFC project, customizing open-source large language models for process automation.
I'm also finishing a technical degree in Electrotechnics at IFCE: microcontrollers, instrumentation, signal conditioning and industrial control.
